:::::: {.home-biography}

My doctoral research focuses on methods for detecting structural breaks in time series. I study how trends and unit roots affect residual-based tests, with broader interests in inference for multivariate models and applications to economics and finance.

I hold master's degrees in {{< meta academic.mqef >}} from the University of Luxembourg, Mathematical Sciences from the African Institute for Mathematical Sciences (AIMS), and Applied Mathematics from the University of Yaoundé I, where I specialised in probability, statistics and finance.
